'''Miroslav Tetter''' (3 April 1938 – 11 August 2021) was a Czech politician and academic. He was a representative of the [[South Bohemian Region]] from 2000 to 2008 and Mayor of [[České Budějovice]] from 1998 to 2006 and again in 2010. In his earlier political career he served in the České Budějovice City Council.

==Biography==
Tetter was born in [[Vsetín]]. From 1957 to 1962, he studied at the {{ill|Přírodovědecká fakulta Masarykovy univerzity|cs|lt=Faculty of Science}} of [[Masaryk University]]. Tetter also graduated from the [[Czech University of Life Sciences Prague]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.whoiswho-verlag.ch/versionnew/tschechien/verlag/63.php?txt_Language=CZ&real_str_PersID=5902035&uniqueID=2e63d3e2-d45b-4786-aa1e-3e886e7b1c6f|title=Tetter Miroslav, doc., RNDr., CSc.|work=Who is Who - Bekannte Persönlichkeiten und Produkte|language=Czech|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402124232/http://www.whoiswho-verlag.ch/versionnew/tschechien/verlag/63.php?txt_Language=CZ&real_str_PersID=5902035&uniqueID=2e63d3e2-d45b-4786-aa1e-3e886e7b1c6f|archivedate=2 April 2015}}</ref> He taught at the agricultural school in České Budějovice. Tetter then became Vice-Rector of Science and head of the ecology department at the {{ill|Zemědělská fakulta Jihočeské univerzity|cs|lt=Faculty of Agriculture}} of [[University of South Bohemia in České Budějovice]].

In 1990, Tetter was elected to the České Budějovice City Council as a member of the [[Club of Committed Non-Party Members]] (KAN).<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=21 October 2006|title=ODS jasně zvítězila v senátních i obecních volbách|trans-title= |url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/clanek/ods-jasne-zvitezila-v-senatnich-i-obecnich-volbach-40135467|language=Czech|work= [[Novinky.cz]]|location= |access-date=15 August 2021}}</ref> In [[1994 Czech municipal elections|1994]], he was re-elected as part of the coalition between [[KDU-ČSL]], KAN, and the [[Christian Democratic Party (Czech Republic)|Christian Democratic Party]] (KDS).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kv1994/kv21111?xjazyk=CZ&xid=1&xv=12&xdz=3&xnumnuts=3301&xobec=544256&xstrana=117|title=Volby do zastupitelstev obcí 18.11. - 19.11.1994|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> He was re-elected in [[1998 Czech municipal elections|1998]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kv1998/kv21111?xjazyk=CZ&xid=0&xv=12&xdz=3&xnumnuts=3101&xobec=544256&xstrana=1|title=Volby do zastupitelstev obcí|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> [[2002 Czech municipal elections|2002]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kv2002/kv21111?xjazyk=CZ&xid=0&xv=12&xdz=3&xnumnuts=3101&xobec=544256&xstrana=1|title=Volby do zastupitelstev obcí|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> and [[2006 Czech municipal elections|2006]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kv2006/kv21111?xjazyk=CZ&xid=0&xv=12&xdz=3&xnumnuts=3101&xobec=544256&xstrana=1|title=Volby do zastupitelstev obcí|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> before being defeated in [[2010 Czech municipal elections|2010]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kv2010/kv21111?xjazyk=CZ&xid=0&xv=12&xdz=3&xnumnuts=3101&xobec=544256&xstrana=1|title=Volby do zastupitelstev obcí|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> Tetter served as Mayor of the city from 1998 to 2006.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.c-budejovice.cz/attachment.ashx?id=1621|title=Zápis u ustavujícího (I.) zasedání Zastupitelstva města České Budějovice konaného dne 2. listopadu 2006 od 9:00 hodin v zasedací místnosti zastupitelstva města|date=3 November 2006|work=Statutární město České Budějovice|language=Czech|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305023854/http://www.c-budejovice.cz/attachment.ashx?id=1621|archivedate=5 March 2016}}</ref> In [[1996 Czech Senate election|1996]] and [[2006 Czech Senate election|2006]], he unsuccessfully ran for the [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Senate]] in the district of {{ill|Senátní obvod č. 14 – České Budějovice|cz|lt=České Budějovice}}. He was elected Mayor of České Budějovice again in 2010,<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=24 June 2010|title=Novým primátorem Českých Budějovicích je Miroslav Tetter|trans-title= |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/regiony/1333388-novym-primatorem-ceskych-budejovicich-je-miroslav-tetter|language=Czech|work=[[Czech Television]]|location= |access-date=15 August 2021}}</ref> serving from 24 June to 23 November.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.c-budejovice.cz/attachment.ashx?id=6125|title=Zápis z ustavujícího (1.) zasedání Zastupitelstva města České Budějovice konaného dne 23. listopadu 2010 od 9:00 hodin v zasedací místnosti zastupitelstva města|date=24 November 2010|work=Statutární město České Budějovice|language=Czech|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923195615/http://www.c-budejovice.cz/attachment.ashx?id=6125|archivedate=23 September 2015}}</ref>

In the [[2000 Czech regional elections|2000 regional election]], Tetter was elected to the South Bohemian Regional Council as part of the [[Four-Coalition]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kz2000/kz111?xjazyk=CZ&xdatum=20001112&xkraj=2&xstrana=12&xv=1&xt=2|title=Volby do zastupitelstev krajů konané dne 12.11.2000|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref> He was re-elected in [[2004 Czech regional elections|2004]], returning the highest number of votes from any candidate on the list.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/kz2004/kz111?xjazyk=CZ&xdatum=20041105&xkraj=2&xstrana=8&xv=1&xt=2|title=Volby do zastupitelstev krajů konané dne 5. - 6.11.2004|work=Volby.cz|language=Czech}}</ref>

Tetter died in České Budějovice on 11 August 2021 at the age of 83.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=13 August 2021|title=Zemřel bývalý primátor Českých Budějovic Miroslav Tetter|trans-title= |url=https://www.c-budejovice.cz/zemrel-byvaly-primator-ceskych-budejovic-miroslav-tetter|language=Czech|work=[[České Budějovice]]|location= |access-date=15 August 2021}}</ref>
